items.content_html:
We leverage an SBOM tool which understands sourceforge URL's for SBOM matching.

The official and supported URL format is "https://sourceforge.net/projects/xxxx/"

Can we please adjust the URL - so that an supported URL format is used? Examples: https://github.com/search?q=repo%3ANixOS%2Fnixpkgs%20%22https%3A%2F%2Fsourceforge.net%2Fprojects%2F%22&type=code

Can you please add a backport tag for 24.11 as well?

nix-community/home-manager#5964

Since the wrapper args are easily added by the user (by using finalAttrs.packpathDirs), I propose we dont set them when wrapRc is set as well.
It's a breaking change for anyone using wrapRc.

items.content_html:
This PR adds Hanabi, a GNOME shell extension that allows you to have animated wallpapers.

This is based off of (well, almost identical to I would say) https://discourse.nixos.org/t/gnome-extention-hanabi-on-nixos/36750/15.

I find my changes to be a bit messy. Feedback welcome. I don't know which inputs are redundant and which aren't.

The software has some rough edges but is otherwise functional (I can't get audio to be muted, for example.)

Package will most likely have to be bumped once #386514 is merged.

items.content_html:
fan2go is a simple daemon providing dynamic fan speed control based on temperature sensors. While we had it packaged in nixpkgs for some time, it's usage is as a daemon, so having module seems natural to me.

I've deployed it to my homelab and it seems to be working just fine. As the daemon has to be running as root, I've removed most of sandboxing in systemd service config, if someone more knowledgeable in the area wants more restricted permissions, please show me an example.
